chunks: With this chain of transmission, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan, from ʿAmr ibn ʿUthmān, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb, from Mālik ibn Aʿyan, who said:
I asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a woman in postnatal bleeding whose husband has intercourse with her while she is in her nifās from blood.

He said: “Yes, when there has passed for her, from the day she gave birth, the measure of the number of days of her menstrual period, then she takes an extra precaution of one day, there is no harm after that in her husband having intercourse with her. He instructs her, then she performs ghusl, then he may have intercourse with her if he wishes.”

And this hadith indicates that the maximum number of days of nifās is like the maximum number of days of hayd, because if it were more than that, intercourse with her by her husband would not be permissible, based on what we mentioned earlier: that intercourse with a woman in nifās is not permissible during the days of her nifās. And among the reports that appear to conflict with what we have mentioned are the like of the following.

key_terms.أَكْثَرَ أَيَّامِ النِّفَاسِ: the maximum duration of postnatal bleeding
key_terms.النُّفَسَاءِ: a woman in the state of postnatal bleeding
key_terms.تَسْتَظْهِرُ: she takes an additional precautionary day
key_terms.حَيْضِهَا: her menstrual period used here as a measure for duration
key_terms.نِفَاسِهَا: her postnatal bleeding period after childbirth

ai.seo_question: When is intercourse permissible after childbirth for a woman in nifās according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses the ruling on intercourse with a woman after childbirth during the period of nifās. It indicates that once the amount of time equal to her normal menstrual days has passed, along with one additional precautionary day, she may perform ghusl and intercourse becomes permissible.
